decisions.why: Polypectomy Snares - Hybrid and Oval are standard GI snare/resection devices for removing polyps endoscopically.
All 9 named products are "Foreign Body Removal Grasping Forceps" — access & retrieval devices used to recover foreign objects or specimens through an endoscope's working channel.
The named product, Retrieval Net - Ball, is an endoscopic specimen/foreign-body retrieval device.
1/2/4-Chamber Polyp Traps capture resected polyp specimens drawn back through the endoscope's suction channel — a retrieval device.
Standard endoscopic tissue-sampling forceps, the same product type already mapped endoscopy:endo for Uniplex's own Biopsy Forceps division.

Blue Eye™ Submucosal Tissue Polyp Lifting Agent is a submucosal lifting agent, the exact example named in this hub tag's own vocabulary description; same product type MedScience Distribution's own Blue Eye™ range is already mapped to.
